sources.quote: Waymo says Singapore will be its next international robotaxi city
Waymo has announced its next international location: Singapore.

claims.statement: Waymo has named Singapore as its next international robotaxi city.

sources.quote: Waymo says it will launch a robotaxi service in Singapore in 2028

claims.statement: The service is planned to launch in 2028.

sources.quote: in preparation of mapping and autonomous testing with human safety drivers behind the wheel in 2027

claims.statement: Mapping and safety-driver testing are planned for 2027.

headline: Waymo names Singapore as its next international robotaxi city
summary: Both reports say Waymo has named Singapore as its next international robotaxi market. One adds detail: a 2028 service launch, vehicles arriving within months, and mapping and autonomous testing with human safety drivers during 2027. The other states the expansion without a timetable. Nothing in the two texts conflicts.
